content:
name: Publish

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: Run npm publish with --dry-run
        type: boolean
        default: false

jobs:
  publish:
    name: Publish Release
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v5
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org/
      - run: npm install
      - run: npm publish ${{ inputs.dry-run == true && '--dry-run' || '' }}
      - if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        run: gh release create "$GITHUB_REF_NAME" --generate-notes --title "$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
